game.q: he’s off to the bathhouse and calls it holy. what’s his reason?
opts: even statues of kings get washed
his students were too polite to say it

wrong.smell: lol. the students were fine. no.

game.right: YES. if kings’ statues get scrubbed and honored, how much more a person made in God’s image.

end.line: hillel called a trip to the baths a holy deed, because a person is made in God’s image.
